# Risk Mitigation Update

Report 023 | Published 2020-06-09 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/risk-mitigation-update/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/023.json)

A small equity reduction responds to speculative sentiment.

This is a modest allocation change, not an explicit crash forecast. A fair audit must follow the cash sleeve until its next documented change and distinguish options volume from net directional exposure.

**Coverage:** All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

The ratio measures traded contract counts, not necessarily directional net buying. Calls can be sold or hedged and institutional/index versus equity options differ. The stated decade low needs the exact series and dated CBOE data.

**Direction:** See reason; no return inferred.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.
